resources.string: Old save states, screenshots, caches and card problems
The card was checked when it was opened, and the system has reported no errors since.

Your games and saves are most likely still on the card. Don\'t format it. Restart the console once. If it stays like this, put the card in a PC and check it (Windows: right-click the drive, Properties, Tools, Check).

The card had a file system error, so the system stopped writing to it. Games still start, but new saves and save states are not kept. Restart the console. If it happens again, check the card on a PC and copy your saves off it.
Restart the console so the card gets checked and repaired. If this comes back, check the card on a PC and copy your saves off it.
The card wasn\'t closed properly last time (flat battery or power pulled). The errors were fixed when it was opened. If a game copied just before that doesn\'t start, copy it again.
Nothing is removed until you pick it and confirm. Takes up to a minute on a full card.
Comparing ROMs of the same size…
Busy with something else, try again in a moment
Will be cleared. Apps make them again when needed.
Save states beyond the newest %1$d of each game. In-game saves (.srm, .sav) and the auto state are never listed.
Save backup copies beyond the newest %1$d in each place (internal storage, EASYROMS). The newest stay. Save backup itself keeps up to the number set there.
Files RetroArch unpacked or kept to start games faster. It makes them again.
Box art and title pictures RetroArch downloaded for its game lists. Getting them back needs Wi-Fi.
Screenshots from RetroArch, PPSSPP and Android. Camera and other pictures are not listed.
App installers in Download and at the top of EASYROMS. Installed apps stay installed.
ROMs that are byte for byte the same as one in another folder. The copy shown under "same as" stays.
And %1$d smaller ones, not shown. Pick all or none decides for them.
%1$d files and folders (%2$s) will be removed. This can\'t be undone.
In-game saves are never removed, and the newest %1$d save states of each game stay. Quit RetroArch and PPSSPP first.
%1$d were left alone because they changed since the search or are in use.

%1$s left. Apps, downloads and screenshots stop working when it\'s full. Tap to free up space.
%1$s left. Apps may stop working. Tap to free up space.
%1$s left on the games card. Games save there, and when it\'s full saves and save states fail. Tap to free up space.
